## RateLimitAdmission type

The outcome of asking a [RateLimiter](./runtime.ratelimiter.md) to admit one call.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type RateLimitAdmission =
  | {
      readonly allowed: true
    }
  | {
      readonly allowed: false
      readonly retryAfterSeconds: number
    }
```

## Remarks

A denial carries `retryAfterSeconds`<!-- -->: a non-negative integer number of seconds after which the same key will be admitted again.
